thread:
Iris (Billing): Heads up — noticed a couple of customers where the dashboard "estimate" dropped suddenly when they crossed a tier boundary. Looks like the snapshot aggregator omitted the 48h grace in the estimate path.
Eve (Docs): Thanks for flagging. We'll need a short docs note and an SDK example tweak. Can you confirm whether final invoices are affected?
Iris (Billing): Final invoices are fine; only the UI/preview snapshots were missing the grace window. Still, Support is getting tickets.
Ravi (Backend): I can patch the aggregator to include grace metadata in estimate snapshots and add a preview param `invoice_aligned=true`. Will add tests.
Sam (SDK): If we add `invoice_aligned`, we should update SDK examples to show the option. Otherwise users calling `billing.getEstimate()` might be surprised.
Noah (Product): Suggest we also surface a small in-app tooltip: "Estimates may exclude short-term grace periods; click for invoice-accurate preview." Keeps customers from opening tickets.
Lina (Support): Please add a short CS note and include the playbook steps: how to generate an invoice-accurate preview and how to explain the diff. I can draft.
deploy-bot: New infra PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/3288 — include grace in preview snapshots (Ravi).
Eve (Docs): Plan: (1) Add a one-paragraph caveat under /docs/platform/billing/estimates.md explaining the discrepancy. (2) Update /docs/sdk/billing_examples.md to show `billing.preview({ invoice_aligned: true })`. (3) Add UI tooltip copy to the admin UI repo docs. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5179 — pinging reviewers.
Ravi (Backend): Rolling the fix to staging now. I'll also add a short API ref note for the new query param.
Sam (SDK): I'll prepare Node + Python snippets and include a short comment: `# use invoice_aligned to match invoices when needed`. PR will reference the docs PR.
Lina (Support): Drafted CS blurb and playbook. Posting to #support so triage knows how to respond.
Eve (Docs): Wording check please: "Estimate preview may temporarily exclude short-term grace windows; for invoice-accurate totals, request an invoice-aligned preview or enable the invoice_aligned flag." Good?
Noah (Product): Nice and short. Ship it.
Eve (Docs): Merged docs draft to staging branch. Will re-open if backend changes. Thanks all. :rocket:
